FN-11TGRLL-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 187
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/14/2025
House Bill 187 as introduced would allow certain existing docket fees that are currently
allocated to the sheriff’s office to be used for the operation of the jail to instead be used for law
enforcement purposes. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
In Fiscal Year 2023, an estimated cumulative total of $575,000 of these fees were disbursed to
sheriffs (average $8,500 per county).
